entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: Phyrexian general who led the opening stages of the Phyrexian Invasion; formerly a captured woman of an anthropomorphic race.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: Evincar of Rath and later commander of the Invasion, who killed and ate Tsabo.

entities.name: Weatherlight crew
entities.description: Crew who fought Tsabo at Benalia.

entities.name: Thaddeus
entities.description: Metathran commander ambushed and vivisected by Tsabo.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Broke his oath of nonviolence to rip off Tsabo's legs.

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: Helped Gerrard break free of Tsabo's spell.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: Phyrexian ruler to whom Tsabo planned to present Gerrard.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: Site of the main battle of the first stage of the Invasion.

events.summary: Tsabo fights Gerrard and the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia.
events.quote: Tsabo fought Gerrard Capashen and the rest of the Weatherlight crew twice during the attack on Benalia

events.summary: At Koilos Tsabo ambushes Thaddeus and has him vivisected.
events.quote: She then had him vivisected to see if Phyrexia could benefit from Urza 's work on the metathran.

events.summary: Tsabo mind-controls Gerrard, making him think she is his mother.
events.quote: Tsabo mind-controlled Gerrard, making him believe she was his "mother".

events.summary: Karn rips off several of Tsabo's legs and Gerrard, helped by Squee, stabs her.
events.quote: Karn broke his oath of nonviolence and ripped several of the Phyrexian's legs off.

events.summary: Tsabo is repaired in Phyrexia, then given to Crovax, who rips her apart and eats her.
events.quote: Crovax ripped her apart and ate her, taking Tsabo's strength for himself.

relations.note: ripped her apart and ate her
relations.quote: Crovax ripped her apart and ate her
She was ordered to report to and serve under Crovax

relations.note: fought and was stabbed by him
relations.quote: Gerrard broke free of her spell and stabbed her in the gut.
